content.short: Mu Digital tokenizes Asian fixed-income credit, letting stablecoin holders earn bond-backed yield.
content.description: Mu Digital brings Asian fixed-income credit on-chain, backing yield with investment-grade bonds and private credit deals rather than crypto-native sources. Asia's credit markets are large and largely closed to outside allocators, which is the gap the product is aimed at rather than a yield comparison with DeFi.
content.meta: Asian credit markets brought onchain, backed by investment-grade bonds and private credit.
